results.evidence: (empty patch) - No code was added to ensure creating a shared metric stores a newly generated internal identifier and discards caller-supplied identifiers.
(empty patch) - The patch contains no code for updating or editing shared metrics, so what is shown is not enough to tell whether existing internal identifiers are preserved.
(empty patch) - No code was added to compare stored inline metrics against attached shared metrics and rewrite clashing inline metrics upon experiment update.
(empty patch) - The patch contains no code showing how attaching non-clashing shared metrics affects stored inline metrics or their display ordering entries, so what is shown is not enough to tell.
(empty patch) - No clash resolution or identifier regeneration logic was implemented, so display ordering containing both identifiers is not implemented.
(empty patch) - No clash resolution logic was implemented to preserve the attached shared metric's identifier and link.
(empty patch) - No changes were made to the agent-facing guidance documentation to stop recommending promoting metrics with the same identifier.
(empty patch) - No code was added to assign a fresh identifier when an update resends an inline metric that clashes with an already-linked shared metric.
